analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see. RSI declined from 70.7 to 67.2 to 61.5, exiting overbought but still near the upper neutral zone. MACD histogram also slowed improvement from 31.3574 to -11.1188, showing lack of direction. Volume ratio increased to 1.27 (above 5-day average), but price is consolidating between swing support at $2,378.39 and resistance at $2,384.47. No clear trend reversal signals confirmed.
